screen.title: Conversation: Extra work-study hours
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student and a financial aid officer.

audio.text: Hi, I'm in the work-study program, and my manager at the library wants me to work more hours this month.
Let's see. Your award covers about ten hours a week. If you go over that, the extra hours wouldn't be paid from work-study funds.
So I'd just lose that money?
Not necessarily. The library could pay you from its own budget, but your manager would have to approve that. Otherwise, you'd want to stay at ten.
Okay. I'll ask her before I agree to anything.

questions.stem: What does the woman want to find out?
options: How to apply for the work-study program
Why her manager reduced her hours
Whether she would be paid for extra hours
Where the library's budget office is located

why.en: Purpose (paraphrase). B reverses the situation: the manager wants more hours.
why.tr: Amaç (parafraz). B durumu tersine çeviriyor: yönetici daha fazla saat istiyor.
why.es: Propósito (paráfrasis). B invierte la situación: es su responsable quien quiere que trabaje más horas.

questions.stem: What is the man's view of the extra hours?
options: They are not allowed under any circumstances.
They are the best way to increase her award.
They will be paid automatically from her work-study award.
They would be paid only if the library covers them.

why.en: Attitude/inference: "not necessarily … the library could pay you from its own budget … your manager would have to approve". A is too extreme; C contradicts him.
why.tr: Tutum/çıkarım: "illa değil… kütüphane kendi bütçesinden ödeyebilir… yönetici onaylamalı". A aşırı; C onunla çelişiyor.
why.es: Actitud/inferencia: "not necessarily … the library could pay you from its own budget … your manager would have to approve". A es demasiado extremo; C le contradice.
